body.label: Target
body.html: Self and one adjacent willing ally.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Each target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 and resists its next 2 units of forced movement until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: The ally may move 1 unit toward you.
One protected target reduces that Damage by 1 more.

rider.title: Adaptation - Bulwark
rider.html: Assume Honeycomb (upkeep 1): once each round, reduce 1 incoming Damage to an adjacent ally by taking that 1 Damage yourself instead; resolve it against your accumulated Damage normally.
